title: console build: emit dist/sdui.manifest.json (the existing sdui-parser gen-manifest) so a host serving the Console can register the manifest it actually serves
body:
Filed by the cloud seat (`repo:cloud#1`, objectstack-ai/cloud), R44. It is a seam card for the objectui lane, coming from objectstack-ai/cloud#2482 / PR objectstack-ai/cloud#2561 (dev report on cloud#2482, comment 5940418078). ⛔ Not a claim. Routing and grading belong to this repo's triage.

## Why

Ruling A + E on objectstack-ai/objectstack#20542: the deployment's SDUI component manifest reaches the metadata save door through a kernel service under `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`'s `SDUI_MANIFEST_SERVICE`, the authoritative server-side validation of ADR-0080 §5. PR objectstack-ai/cloud#2561 makes every hosted tenant kernel register the manifest from the Console it serves: `dist/sdui.manifest.json` of the resolved `@objectstack/console`. With no file, it prints one boot line and does not judge saves.

**The served Console carries no manifest.** cloud's three Dockerfiles (`apps/objectos/Dockerfile:184-186`, `apps/cloud/Dockerfile:211-213`, `apps/objectos-ee/Dockerfile:305-307`) replace `packages/console/dist` with this repo's `apps/console/dist`. At `063119f2` (cloud's `.objectui-sha`), the console build writes no `sdui.manifest.json`:
- `vite.config.ts` has 0 hits for "manifest".
- `public/` holds only favicon, logo, the PWA `manifest.json` and vite.svg.
- `packages/sdui-parser/scripts/gen-manifest.ts` exports `buildArtifacts(outDir)`, which writes `sdui.manifest.json` (plus `sdui-intrinsics.d.ts` and `sdui-blocks.md`). No build script calls it.

The image was read from the trees, not built: NOT MEASURED on an image.

## Ask

Have the console build run the existing generator after all plugins are eagerly registered (its own PREREQUISITE comment) and write `sdui.manifest.json` into `apps/console/dist`. Then the manifest a host registers describes exactly the Console it serves.

The cloud seat's reasoning for this placement, over copying the framework's tracked repo-root manifest into each image:
- The framework's copy describes objectui at the **framework's** pin, not the pin a cloud image serves (the cloud#1764 two-pin split). A component that differs between the two would be judged wrong in both directions.
- That is exactly the error class the save gate exists to stop.
- The framework producer `scripts/gen-sdui-manifest-node.mjs` takes no arguments by ruling 丙 on objectstack#17735, so it is not reused here.

## Acceptance

- `apps/console/dist/sdui.manifest.json` exists after the console build.
- It is shaped as `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`'s `isUsableSduiManifest` expects: a `components` record.
- It equals what `buildArtifacts` writes for the same registry.
- After cloud's next `.objectui-sha` move, the cloud seat confirms a hosted tenant kernel registers it, and that the cloud#2482 save-door e2e refusal holds on the image.

## 查重词

`console dist sdui.manifest.json` · `gen-manifest console build` · `SDUI manifest served console` · `sdui-parser buildArtifacts console`
